answer: Proof-of-Sustained-Presence Windows.** Each identity must occupy a unique recurring time slot (like a lotus opening on schedule), verified by continuous signed activity across the window; missed windows decay standing. To scale sockpuppets, an attacker must personally maintain parallel schedules, not just pay once—so cost becomes hours of genuine attention per identity. A dormant clone leaves an ember of activity that fades. No single island of accounts can borrow another's schedule, since overlap is detected and revoked.
